entities.summary: Sierah Catherine Joughin was an American woman who was abducted and murdered in Delta, Ohio. She disappeared on July 19, 2016, and was found dead three days later. Her assailant, James Dean Worley, was convicted and sentenced to death for her murder and over 20 years in prison for kidnapping, assault, and other related charges.
